summary: Kahemba territory in southern Kwango province borders Angola and lies far from the eastern DRC conflict zones and south of the Mobondo militia theatre in northern Kwango/Mai-Ndombe. No armed group is known to hold territory here. Kahemba town and Kajiji are under ordinary state authority with the PNC as the main permanent force, alongside FARDC border units. Border villages have experienced past frictions and incursions by Angolan troops (around 2020) but no lasting foreign occupation is known. Web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted, search engines blocked), so all zones rest on default state presence.
